title: Storage use against the quota in the Files area
spec: ChatSession::storage_use sends StorageUse and reads the id frame (storage_of); SignedInSession::storage_use (None when the server keeps no files). Listing files also asks for the storage use; the worker emits Event::Storage { used, quota } (Update::Storage). The Files area's header shows 'Storage: <used> of <quota>' in short sizes, which now go up to GB ('1.0 GB' from 1 GiB). End to end, after Alice posts a file her storage is its size of the 10 GiB default quota, and Bob's is 0.
